requirement.summary: Incorrect calculation for Municipality tax after waive by override condition
requirement.description:
It is available for Shiji Fiscal Exchange interface

Setup:

1. Setting for turn on municipality tax

*  Location: System Management > System Configuration > POS module

> Setup name: Support municipality tax

>> Value: Yes

2. Setting for tax setup with municipality tax

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Tax & S.C. Types

> Select target Tax (index: 1)

> Setting name: Rate (%)

>> Value: 24

> Setting name: Municipality Tax Index

>> Value: Select target tax index as Municipality Tax (index: 9)

> Setting name: Municipality Rate (%)

>> Value: Target tax rate for Municipality Tax (0.5%)

3. Setting for municipality tax setup

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Tax & S.C. Types

> Select target Tax as municipality tax  (index: 9)

> Setting name: Rate (%)

>> Value: 24 (same tax rate as Rate (%) on setup 2)

4. Setting for override condition for waive Municipality Tax

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Override Conditions

> Create / Edit target  Override Condition

> Under tab "General"

> Setting name: Custom Type

>> Value: Select target check type

> Select tab "Tax & S.C."

> Setting name: Tax 9

>> Value: Waive Tax for All Items

5. Setting for apply override conditions on old item when check type is changed

*  Location: POS System > Ordering Setup> Config by Location > Override Conditions Setting

> Select target Tax as municipality tax  (index: 9)

> Setting name: Apply override conditions on old items when check type is changed

>> Value: Yes

Workflow

1. Open new check

2. Order item with (Tax 1 and Municipality Tax 9 )

3. Click function "Assign Check Type" to select the target check to trigger override condition

4. System applys override condition to waive tax

* Municipality Tax 9 is waived

5. System wrongly calculates the check after waived Municipality Tax and posts the incorrect value to SFE

*  Tax 1 still calculated with the Municipality tax rate, and Municipality Tax is waived from check that the transaction total is matched on SFE packet

Expected result

System calculates the check after waived  Municipality Tax correctly and posts the expected value to SFE

*  Tax rate of tax 1 should rollback to 24% after Municipality Tax  (tax 9) is waived

*  Reference to attachment "Expected posting packet for SFE after waive Municipality tax (Provided by SFE)"

# POS0099 - Cross Outlet Revenue Report (Mix Revenue/Non-Revenue Payment)

## Report Information

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Cross Outlet Revenue Report (Mix Revenue/Non-Revenue Payment) |
| Code | POS0099 |

## Parameters to Validate

| Parameters Name | Description | Options | Default | Platform Setting/Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Date Type | Select the business date or date range of the report (single-select). Current Business Day: for a single outlet display the day that "Daily Start" performed, for multiple/all outlets display the largest business day of the selected outlets; Last Business Day: for a single outlet display the day that "Daily Close" performed, for multiple/all outlets display the largest business day of the selected outlets; Current Month: show current month data; Specified Date / Specified Date Range: show the specified day / period data | Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Current Month, Specified Date, Specified Date Range | Current Business Day | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit |
| Shops | Filter report data by shop (multi-select) | All, Single, Multiple | All | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Outlets | Filter report data by outlet (multi-select) | All, Single, Multiple | All | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Department Level | Select the department level to display (single-select). Main Department: data from sub-departments are merged into the main department; Sub Department: show sub department information | Main Department, Sub Department | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit |
| Payment Method | Filter report data by payment method (multi-select). Note: show payment method name based on the config zone; if the target config zone does not set an override name, show the nearest parent config zone name | All, Single, Multiple | All | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Payment Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit |
| Display Figure | Select the sales figure to display (single-select). Net: show net sales of item department; Gross: show gross sales of item department | Net, Gross | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Revenue/Non-Revenue | Filter data by revenue type (single-select). All: show information of both revenue and non-revenue payment methods; Payment (Revenue): show revenue payment information; Payment (Non-revenue): show non-revenue payment information | All, Payment (Revenue), Payment (Non-revenue) | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Display 25 Tax | Whether to display the 25 tax detail columns (single-select). Hide: do not show tax detail information; Display: show tax detail information | Hide, Display | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Attributes Condition | Condition to combine the selected attribute keys (single-select). And: show information satisfying all selected attribute keys; Or: show information satisfying any selected attribute key | And, Or | QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 | - |
| Attribute Key | Filter report data by attribute key (multi-select); works together with Attributes Condition | All, Single, Multiple | All | - |
| Display Discount | Whether to display the discount section (single-select). Hide: hide discount section; Display: show discount section | Hide, Display | Display | - |
| Split Covers By Revenue Type | Whether to split guests by payment revenue type (single-select). Yes: guests are allocated by rounding off the payment ratio according to revenue type, the type with a larger proportion is given priority, the remaining guests are allocated to the other type; if ratios are the same, the revenue type that made the payment earlier is given priority; No: regardless of whether the first payment is revenue or non-revenue, guests of new checks are always added to the Revenue list | Yes, No | No | - |
| Display Discount By Department | Whether to display the discount by department section (single-select); enabled when Display Discount = 'Display'. Hide: do not display discount by department section; Show: display discount by department section | Hide, Show | Hide | - |

## Data Fields to Validate

### Report Header

| Fields Name | Fields Description | Field Calculation | Platform Setting/Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shop Name | Show specified shop name; show "Shop Name" only when one shop is selected, not shown for multiple or all shops | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No |
| Report Title | Show corresponding report name: Cross Outlet Revenue Report (Mix Revenue/Non-Revenue Payment) | - | - |

| *All | Show "*All" in the report header | - | - |
| Business Day | Show specified date or date range | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock |
| Display Figure | Header indicator; show "Net" when parameter "Display Figure" = 'Net', show "Gross" when 'Gross' | - | - |

| Tax | Show add-on tax amount | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |
| Incl. Tax | Show inclusive tax amount | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |

| Total | Show check total | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |
| Tips | Show tips and residue | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |
| Disct Amt | Show discount amount (including item discount, check discount and extra charge) | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |
| Tax Name | Dynamic column(s) per tax index; show add-on tax amount for each tax index. Note: column displays only when parameter "Display 25Tax" = 'Display', hidden when 'Hide' | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |
| Department Name | Dynamic column(s) per item department; show department sales amount. Note: 1. if the item does not set an item department in the platform, department name shows "Undefined"; 2. show department net sales when "Display Figure" = 'Net'; 3. show department gross sales when "Display Figure" = 'Gross' | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: .; Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit |
| Sub Total | Show total of all columns for an outlet | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |
| Grand Total | Show total of all columns for all outlets | - | Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . |
